meta.name: acreadiness-policy
meta.description: Help the user pick, write, or apply an AgentRC policy. Policies customise readiness scoring by disabling irrelevant checks, overriding impact/level, setting pass-rate thresholds, or chaining org baselines with team overrides. Use when the user asks about strict mode, AI-only scoring, custom weights, CI gating, or wants org-wide standardisation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AgentRC 策略以调整就绪度评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AgentRC 中自定义检查规则或评分标准
copy.tagline_en: Customize AgentRC policies to adjust readiness scoring
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to customize check rules or scoring criteria in AgentRC

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你查看当前生效的策略、新建自定义策略文件，或应用一个策略来调整备便度评分的规则。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于策略、严格模式、自定义评分、禁用检查、组织标准或CI门控时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看当前有哪些策略在生效。
say.note: Claude 会显示当前策略列表或提示无策略。

say.text: 新建一个名为 strict-frontend 的策略。
say.note: Claude 会引导你配置禁用项、覆盖项和通过率阈值。

say.text: 应用 policies/strict.json 策略并显示报告。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you view current active policies, create a new policy file, or apply a policy to customize readiness scoring rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about policies, strict mode, custom scoring, disabling checks, org standards, or CI gating.

say_en.note: Claude lists active policies or says none.

say_en.text: Create a new policy called strict-frontend.
say_en.note: Claude guides through disabling, overriding, and thresholds.

say_en.text: Apply policies/strict.json and show the report.
say_en.note: Claude applies the policy, runs readiness, and shows the report.
